messages:
nina (Billing): Heads-up 12 4B8 Bluehaven Analytics INV-2026-1288 is 60 days overdue (USD 12,400). AP says they're consolidating payments into an escrow account pending an invoice reconciliation between their procurement and legal. They asked if we can accept escrow remittance + temporary credit memo to avoid service suspension. Thoughts?
omar (Collections): For >$10k this triggers exec & RevOps approval. We usually require: signed escrow agreement, proof of funds in escrow, and a binding payment plan. Otherwise risk of revenue leakage.
rebecca (FinOps): Escrow is workable but complex for revenue recognition. If funds are verifiably in escrow, we can record a restricted cash deposit and recognize revenue per contract terms after release. Need FP&A + RevOps sign-off and GL mapping. Also CFO must approve credit memo >$1k.
carlos (Legal): We need to review the escrow agreement. Key asks: beneficiary clause naming Redwood Inference, release triggers (PO + invoice reconciliation), indemnity for routing errors, and an audit right. Also require a clause that escrow does not waive our right to suspend if funds are not deposited by the deadline.
melissa (Revenue Ops): Material change to payment flow impacts revenue deferral schedule. If we accept escrow, we must capture the deferral and set an internal milestone for release. Also need to confirm whether the contract allows third-party escrow. If not, customer must sign amendment.
nina (Billing): Customer offered: place $12,400 in a 30-day escrow, provide proof of wire to escrow agent by EOD tomorrow, and accept a provisional credit memo to clear their AP hold so they can process subsequent invoices. They also asked to waive any pending collection marks if escrow confirmed.
omar (Collections): Do not waive collection marks until funds land. We can offer a provisional credit memo (not a cash refund) that is conditional on escrow funds being verified. If they default, the credit memo is reversed and normal collections resume.
rebecca (FinOps): Suggest: provisional credit memo = $12,400 (to unlock reconciliation) conditional on: 1) signed escrow agreement acceptable to Legal, 2) confirmation of funds in escrow agent's account, 3) signed contract amendment if needed. Finance will require GL tag 4207-RESTRICTED-CASH and CFO sign-off for the memo.
carlos (Legal): I'll prioritize a 2-page escrow addendum template. Request Legal approval turn-around 4 hours if they send the draft now. Include a clause for audit rights and a 7-day cure period before service suspension.
melissa (Revenue Ops): If all conditions met, Revenue Ops will accept the deferral and create the release milestones. We'll need copy of escrow bank statement or agent confirmation.
ar-bot: System note: invoice INV-2026-1288 status changed to "escrow_pending" by nina (Billing) at 2210012400.
nina (Billing): Okay I'll send the escrow addendum request to the customer now and ask for proof of wire. Omar please prepare conditional credit memo template and tie it to the escrow terms.
omar (Collections): On it. Draft ready in 20m. Will include reversal mechanics and escalation steps.
rebecca (FinOps): Finance prelim approval contingent on CFO sign-off. I've looped CFO and FP&A. If they greenlight, we'll map GL and reversal workflow. Please tag this for the weekly AR note.
carlos (Legal): Drafted the addendum and uploaded it to the customer portal. Requested signature and bank confirmation by COB tomorrow.
nina (Billing): Customer replied: escrow agent confirms funds will be available and they'll sign addendum today. They asked for a one-time statement removing 'collections' flag from their vendor record if funds are verified.
om ar (Collections): Typo? (quick reply)
omar (Collections): We will remove public collection flags internally upon confirmation of escrow funds but we will not change the historical notes. Any external reporting remains subject to standard reporting windows.
rebecca (FinOps): Noted. Once funds are verified Finance will post restricted cash and apply provisional credit memo. We'll run the reversal process if funds not released per escrow terms.
nina (Billing): Great. I'll mark follow-up for 48h. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
